text_block_list.text:
There is a festival held once every twelve 
years 
to honor the bond between horsegirls and 
humans. 
—Its name is the "Goshiki Shuntaisai."

It was recently covered in <chrname>'s class, 
and the students were assigned a report 
on the theme of "The Bond Between 
Horsegirls and Humans."
choice_data_list:
I can help you look for reference 
materials between jobs!

I'd be glad to help you search for 
materials during a break.

text_block_list.text:
Visiting the Shuntaisai headquarters, I 
found Azuma-san, 
the shrine maiden overseeing the 
festival's affairs.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
—Greetings, my lord. 
I understand you are searching for certain 
texts?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Our archives preserve countless volumes 
chronicling the exchanges between 
horsegirls and humankind. 
I am certain you will find the materials 
you seek.

Just as Azuma-san said, 
the archives were stocked with fascinating 
texts.
choice_data_list:
Fascinating... There are signs of 
companionship even in mythology.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
choice_data_list:
Horsegirls played a major role in cultural 
development as well.

text_block_list.text:
The history of walking hand-in-hand 
with horsegirls was captivating in every 
detail, 
and I couldn't stop turning pages.
choice_data_list:
Is it really this late already—oh, 
Azuma-san?!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. 
You have been engrossed for quite some 
time, I see.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
It brings me great joy to see you 
appreciate the history of horsegirls and 
humans so deeply.

I got so carried away that 
I've only skimmed through a few books. 
I need to look for more materials we can 
use—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. 
Your visit today was for the sake of 
Lady <chrname>'s "report," was it not?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
If you would convey the outline of the 
references you require, 
I shall guide you to each of their 
locations without fail.
choice_data_list:
You have the location of every single book 
memorized?!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I have tended to these archives 
for a very long time, after all.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Should the required texts prove too 
voluminous, 
I could also recite their contents 
directly to you.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
For I have committed every word of them to 
memory as well.
choice_data_list:
Memorized... every single book in the 
archives...?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Precisely. 
Written texts are the very footprints of 
history. 
It would be a pity to let them fade from 
memory.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Should you encounter any points of 
ambiguity 
regarding their interpretation, pray do 
not hesitate to ask.

Her casual delivery leaves me utterly 
speechless. 
It defies all ordinary comprehension... 
but perhaps 
such feats are only natural for a shrine 
maiden of the Goshiki Shuntaisai?
choice_data_list: T-That would be an enormous help...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it. 
It is a simple matter.
